purpose: Fresh response-blind real-data validation of whether the v2 contextual EOG representation translates the known-truth mechanism diagnosis into heldout predictive improvement.

dataset.name: Portal Project long-term rodent monitoring, Arizona
dataset.selection_basis: long repeated plot-by-time monitoring with response-independent trapping effort, plot treatment metadata and spatial coordinates physically separated from the rodent capture response

focal_taxon.selection_rule: fixed from taxonomic metadata and site-study relevance before response access; no prevalence ranking

unit.response_after_authorization: 1 iff at least one DM capture occurs in the same positive period and plot; otherwise 0 for an eligible sampled plot-period

geometry.node_coordinate: mean easting/northing of type=corner records within plot
geometry.distance: Euclidean metres in supplied UTM coordinates
geometry.local_worlds: q25/q50/q75/q90 of nonzero pairwise plot-centroid distances computed response-blind

layer_a.update: sequential by census period using calibration-period positives only
layer_a.source_set: plots positive for DM in prior authorized calibration contexts only

split.rule: after Stage0 eligible positive census periods are enumerated response-blind, first 75% are calibration/training and final 25% are heldout scoring; boundary is frozen before Portal_rodent.csv access

primary_metric: macro heldout binary log loss by census period
primary_estimand: augmented minus baseline macro heldout log loss
stage0_gates_before_response: four distinct positive local geometry thresholds
ordered 75/25 split with at least 20 heldout census periods
baseline design fully materializable without response
contextual v2 projection passes source/world label invariance and saturated-static-identity safeguards on synthetic placeholder state
forbidden_before_stage0_pass: open, preview or download Portal_rodent.csv body
change learner or baseline after response
